question: Who took charge as the Vice Chief of the Air Staff of the Indian Air Force on 2 May 2025?

options.text: Air Marshal Rakesh Kumar Singh Bhadauria

solution:
The correct answer is __**Air Marshal Narmdeshwar Tiwari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On **2 May 2025**, **Air Marshal Narmdeshwar Tiwari** assumed charge as the **Vice Chief of the Air Staff** of the **Indian Air Force** (IAF).
 
• The position of Vice Chief of the Air Staff is one of the most significant roles in the IAF, second only to the Chief of Air Staff, and involves overseeing the operational and administrative functions of the force.
 
• Air Marshal Narmdeshwar Tiwari is an experienced officer with vast expertise in aviation operations, strategic planning, and military leadership. *Hence, option 4 is correct.*
 
• This appointment is part of a regular rotation and succession process in the armed forces to ensure smooth operations and strategic continuity.
